rule: Round 11 (PhysioFlow-2), fixed before training. Pack ppg_physioflow2_v4. Arms U2 (two-channel U-Net) and T2 (DiT-1D), recipe: uniform flow times, first-difference weight 1 and stop-band log-PSD weight 0.1 on each channel, red terms only where red is known, 20000 steps, batch 128, AdamW 3e-4 with cosine decay, 16 Heun steps; checkpoints every 2000 steps on infrared S_real + 0.5C. Gates: finite, not flat, rho in [0.75, 1.25], TorchScript agreement, single-thread latency < 5000 ms. Pilot (seed 42): an arm is eligible if it passes every gate and the median |R_generated - R_prompted| on the red validation windows is <= 0.05; the winner is the eligible arm with the lowest S_arm, U2 within 0.02; with no eligible arm the round stops. Final: the winner at seeds 123 and 2026 plus the pilot seed. D1 (the two-channel model replaces PhysioFlow F6 as the research mode): every seed eligible; seed-mean S_arm <= F6 mean + pooled SD; seed-mean wrist-exercise Q <= 0.587; seed-mean two-channel 'indistinguishable' on the red validation windows exceeds the infrared-copy baseline's by more than 2 x max(seed SD of the model, seed SD of the copy). D2 (the two-channel model replaces PhysioMix R9 as the app default): D1 and the R9 rule of round 10: S_arm gap to R9 > pooled SD, seed-mean S_real <= R9 S_real + 0.05, seed-mean S_arm <= 0.559. Shipped seed: the eligible seed with the lowest S_arm. Validation only; test splits are not used.
